title: Perfect matchings and permutations
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix. The bipartite graph with an edge from left vertex $i$ to right vertex $j$ exactly when $A_{ij}$ is true has a perfect matching if and only if there is a permutation $\sigma$ of the indices such that $A_{i,\sigma(i)}$ is true for every $i$.
